design: Anchor model: full trajectory + scaling laws + milestone timing
mechanism: Schooling–government–market interaction on one system; no portability yet
data_required: GMR/UIS observed GER 1971-2024; completion 1999-2024; jobs panel; events (K12 2013, free SHS 2016, free tertiary 2018; nurse visa 2005-06; BPO)
arms: anchor model vs 3 rivals; event-conditional vs unconditional
threshold: levels 5/8pp + beat persistence/trend; M0-M4 within +/-5y; scaling in A3 range; event breaks sign+band

design: State-push event battery (K-12 2013; free SHS 2016; free tertiary 2018; places/teachers)
mechanism: Compulsory/cycle extension, fee abolition, capacity expansion raise intake/completion with predeclared lags
data_required: Observed completion 1999-2024; DepEd/DPWH school/teacher series (web search); RA 10533 timeline
arms: event vs pre-trend; exposed cohorts vs placebo; income-quartile differential for fee abolition
estimand: break at event date; cohort DiD; income-gradient response
threshold: pre-trends pass; break sign+magnitude in predeclared band; placebo null; fee effects concentrated Q1-Q2

design: Demand-pull battery (nurse visa 2005-06; BPO regional growth; remittances)
mechanism: Foreign/domestic demand raises expected returns and pulls schooling/field choice
data_required: Published nurse design (simulated-only if no series); BPO/industry regional data; remittances (ECONOMY_SERIES)
arms: field-specific (nursing) vs placebo fields; high- vs low-BPO regions; remittance-rich vs poor

mechanism: Schooling expansion may create jobs (positive) or be absorbed in informality/queue (R13)
arms: education-led vs demand-led vs queue model on same record
threshold: sign: positive would support job creation; ~0/negative = queue; report R13

design: Rival-model comparison on the same record
mechanism: Different people's models: HC (Becker/Mincer), world culture (Meyer/Schofer), labour queue (Thurow/Collins), state-building (Paglayan), sectoral demand (Lewis/Kuznets)
data_required: Same PHL pre-2013 record + exogenous events; predict 2013-2024 and event breaks
arms: each rival fitted identically; anchors vs rivals; placebo
threshold: anchor must beat rivals on event breaks and OOS, else EQUIVALENT (R3)

design: Transfer test: 1986 compulsory law, 1999 expansion, 2006 fee abolition
mechanism: Portability of behavioural core to a massifying state-push system
data_required: UIS/GMR observed; policy dates; national sources (web)
arms: PHL-estimated parameters fixed; only country inputs re-set
threshold: §3 tolerances + timing +/-5y; event breaks predeclared; no behavioural re-fit (R20)

design: Transfer test: 1971/1978 compulsory expansion; 2012 HKDSE context; near-universal timing
mechanism: Portability to a near-universal system: timing, not level
data_required: 1971/1978 policy dates; observed series (no UIS completion; reconstructed timing)
arms: PHL parameters fixed; country inputs re-set; timing regime
threshold: timing +/-5y (+/-3 narrow); left-censored boundary; no level fitting

design: Baseline-data web pull (pre-1999 completion, places/teachers, fee/event dates)
mechanism: Fill anchor gaps from UNESCO/World Bank/national public sources; enables A1-A3
data_required: UIS/World Bank/national public tables; web search with source+vintage; no imputation as observation
threshold: all series observed-labelled, sourced, vintaged; DATA BLOCKED where absent
